title: CatalogObject
description: A single object in the tracked catalogue, derived from a CelesTrak GP/TLE record.

norad_id.description: NORAD catalogue number, the stable identifier for the object.

name.description: Human-readable object name as published by the source catalogue.

tle_line1.description: Raw TLE line 1, 69 characters, unmodified from source.

tle_line2.description: Raw TLE line 2, 69 characters, unmodified from source.

epoch_age_hours.description: Hours elapsed between epoch and the time this record was screened. Drives confidence decay.

object_type.description: Coarse object classification from the source catalogue.

rcs_size.description: Radar cross-section bucket as published by the source catalogue.

radius_m.description: Assumed hard-body radius in metres, derived from rcs_size via the lookup table documented in prahari_orbital.scoring.

perigee_km.description: Perigee altitude above a spherical Earth, kilometres, derived from the mean elements at epoch.

apogee_km.description: Apogee altitude above a spherical Earth, kilometres, derived from the mean elements at epoch.
